register_source_model_config: register a new pydantic source model config class against a supported torax source name
validate_source_model_config: validate that a source model config class has a model_name attribute and a non-default model function name
test_register_source_model_config: test the register_source_model_config function with a custom source model config class
review_register_source_model_config: review the register_source_model_config function for updating pydantic schemas dynamically
refactor_validate_source_model_config: refactor the _validate_source_model_config function to support additional source types
